description: Implementation of the PlatformManager class for managing network interfaces, ARP and DHCP monitoring, and communication with agents in the prplMesh project.

classes.name: PlatformManager
classes.description: Manages network interfaces, ARP and DHCP monitoring, and communication with agents in the prplMesh platform.

methods.name: query_db
methods.description: Queries platform database parameters such as master, gateway, or onboarding status.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the platform manager, including timers, interfaces, and monitors.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all monitors, timers, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: send_cmdu_to_agent_safe
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message to the agent in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: get_agent_socket
methods.description: Returns the current agent socket file descriptor.

methods.name: load_iface_params
methods.description: Loads interface parameters into internal maps.

methods.name: bridge_iface_from_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the bridge interface name associated with a MAC address.

methods.name: send_dhcp_notification
methods.description: Builds and sends a DHCP event notification.

methods.name: check_wlan_params_changed
methods.description: Checks if WLAN parameters have changed and notifies if so.

methods.name: handle_connected
methods.description: Handles new socket connection events.

methods.name: handle_disconnected
methods.description: Handles socket disconnection events.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Processes incoming CMDU messages from the agent.

methods.name: handle_arp_monitor
methods.description: Processes ARP monitor notifications.

methods.name: handle_arp_raw
methods.description: Processes raw ARP packets.

methods.name: clean_old_arp_entries
methods.description: Removes stale ARP entries based on inactivity timeout.

methods.name: init_arp_monitor
methods.description: Initializes ARP monitoring, including socket setup and timers.

methods.name: stop_arp_monitor
methods.description: Stops ARP monitoring and cleans up related resources.

methods.name: restart_arp_monitor
methods.description: Restarts ARP monitoring by stopping and reinitializing.

methods.name: init_dhcp_monitor
methods.description: Initializes DHCP monitoring and event handling.

methods.name: stop_dhcp_monitor
methods.description: Stops DHCP monitoring and cleans up resources.
